cause.metricNotFound: The metrics API has no such metric: check the metric name and selector.
cause.missingRequest: Container {{container}} of Pod {{pod}} has no {{resource}} request, so its utilization cannot be computed. Sidecars injected at admission count too.
cause.noCustomMetrics: The custom metrics API (custom.metrics.k8s.io) does not answer: no metrics adapter (such as prometheus-adapter) serves it.
cause.noExternalMetrics: The external metrics API (external.metrics.k8s.io) does not answer: no adapter (such as KEDA) serves it.
cause.noMetricsServer: The resource metrics API (metrics.k8s.io) does not answer: metrics-server is missing or not ready.
cause.noPodMetrics: The pods have no metrics yet: they are not ready or started too recently.
common.nothingToShow: Nothing to show in the {{view}} view.
hpa.noMetrics: No metrics are set: the HPA uses the default of 80% CPU utilization.
keda.active: Active: a trigger is above its activation threshold, so the HPA scales the target (replicas: {{min}}–{{max}}).
keda.fallback: Fallback is in use: a trigger keeps failing, so the target runs the fallback replica count: {{replicas}}.
keda.hpaMissing: The HPA {{name}} that KEDA manages for this ScaledObject is not there.
keda.inactive: Inactive: no trigger is above its activation threshold, so the HPA keeps the target at minReplicaCount: {{replicas}}.
keda.inactiveIdle: Inactive: no trigger is above its activation threshold, so the target is kept at its idle replica count: {{replicas}}.
keda.jobActive: Active: a trigger is above its activation threshold, so KEDA creates Jobs (maxReplicaCount: {{max}}).
keda.jobInactive: Inactive: no trigger is above its activation threshold, so no Jobs are created.
keda.name: Name
keda.notReady: KEDA cannot scale this object ({{reason}}): see the Ready condition and the events.
keda.paused: Paused by the annotation {{annotation}}: KEDA does not scale the target.
keda.pausedAt: Paused by the annotation {{annotation}}: the target is held at this replica count: {{replicas}}.
keda.title: KEDA
keda.triggerFailing_one: Trigger {{trigger}} failed {{count}} time in a row.
keda.triggerFailing_other: Trigger {{trigger}} failed {{count}} times in a row.

verdict.atMin_one: At the minimum of {{count}} replica: the metrics ask for fewer (by this estimate: {{wanted}}).
verdict.atMin_other: At the minimum of {{count}} replicas: the metrics ask for fewer (by this estimate: {{wanted}}).
